lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Mara, the gale arrives tonight. Every ship in the bay will be looking for your light.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Then I'll light it. I always do.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Not without the keeper's key. The harbour log says it was signed out last week, and never returned.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Signed out? Nobody touches that key but me.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: Find it before dark, or I close the harbour.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Top drawer. It has been in the top drawer for eleven years.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Empty. Just a letter.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Meet me at the north cliff at midnight. Signed, T.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: T. Of course it's T.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Theo. Where is the keeper's key?

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: Good evening to you too, sister.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Your letter was in the drawer. Signed T. Don't play games with me tonight.

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: You never listen. Not to me, not to Dad, not to anyone.

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: Midnight. North cliff. Come or don't.

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: I didn't steal it. I moved it, the way Dad told me to, before he died.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Dad told you? He never told me anything.

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: He drew this. Look. An X on the north cliff.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Under the old signal post. He always said the light belongs to the cliff.

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: Bring the lantern.

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: Hold the lantern lower. There, by the post.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Something metal. A tin box.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: It's the key. The brass key. It was here all along.

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: Dad wanted us to find it together. That's why I wrote the letter.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: It's almost one. I was about to close the harbour.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: No need. We have the key.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: We? Theo Quinn, I thought you'd left for good.

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: Not tonight, Inspector.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Eleven years. Same key, same lock.

lines.speaker: theo
lines.text: Turn it.

lines.speaker: hale
lines.text: There. Every ship in the bay can see it now.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Thank you, Theo.
